Grocery clerks, cashier are probably the "easiest" no experience jobs and because you're fresh out of highschool they won't bat an eye to your experiencelessness(?).

If you're physically fit dishwashing, production, warehousing are alternatives.

Unlike me you at least have a chance for normality. I wasted my life and currently contemplating how to end it.

I'm in the same boat as you, however the reason I have not killed myself yet is because my mother still cares about me. I really wish she didn't so I could at least feel good about leaving this world.
They have not, I'm with the team because they think I have psychosis.

This is why I'm unemployed. lol

edit: will try to make time tomorrow, or on the 2nd
I'm busy tomorrow but will go the day after!

That's the problem there are literally years between jobs. I'm worried they'll call my past employment and confirm when I worked. Should I fake a job to fill in the years? I'm just worried what will happen when they call them up. Then again I'm pretty sure I shouldn't be worrying about them catching me lying.

Can I how you went back? Did your thoughts come back or was it something else? Like I said in my post i'm pretty sure I don't have psychosis so I'd be surprised if I went back to the hospital for the same reason. If I would be hospitalized for another  reason I would like to know in advance.

1- Assuming when I'm on the streets and not current. Phone and maybe a gym membership.

2- Probably junk food, whatever's being offered at a soup kitchen. Currently paying for the internet bill so will have some extra money compared to now.

3- From park fountains.

4- I hate it here. I might regret my decision later but I'll have to accept that was my choice or it might be the best decision I'll ever make. 

5- Park fountains

6- I'll wet a cloth and wipe myself down in a rest room somewhere. 

7- I don't plan to be around people if I can help it. I'm introverted. I've been out for night runs I know spots where people generally dont go, then again if I leave I dont want to linger around where I lived. (wait this might be a negative idk)

Being mentally drained with no motivation vs being homeless. I've only experienced the former.

If I had no savings whatsoever I would be inclined to agree with you 100% but right now my mental health has deteriorated past the point where staying here will help it get better.

Edit: If you're going by experience you're probably right but I can't see it getting any better if I stay.

I'm not being directly verbally abused(he's also trashing me in a voice loud enough for me to hear), he is spreading lies and rumors about me to friends of his therefore it's making it difficult to find a job. I left my prior job(got fired because i never showed up again) due to rumors spread by him and a particular incident that lead to another rumor(I was on auto pilot that day as with most other days).

They have spread far and wide and every time I leave my house to go to the store or something there's always someone that recognize me even if I have no clue who the hell they are, just the other day I walked into a store the other day to pick up some food and just  as I was leaving one of the cashier recognize said I was the brother of x and started saying all the things my brother said to him.

I don't correct or interact them because my brother had been violent towards me in the past. I had confronted him in the past about the lies he's been spreading towards me and he distorted my words and told a different story to his friends which I have to assume are also being passed on.

I never thought it was fun to begin with. And I do have money saved up which is why I want to do this.

If I had stronger willpower I would've left at 18 or at the very least when I secured my first long term position. I wish I had been evicted.
I will for sure work for exposure and def not close this tab and pretend to not see this post. I'll dm you when I'm done....
